_about: Seek minibrot (N, kb: decisions/controls "Seek minibrot") twice from the needle view: the first N finds the period-4640 minibrot (size 1e-67, ~7 view radii off) and flies there, the second goes on to the copy of the period-3 minibrot on its antenna (period 13920).
